summary: Campbell's filed an 8-K reporting the pricing and issuance of $300 million of 8.500% Fixed-to-Fixed Reset Rate Junior Subordinated Notes due April 5, 2057, priced October 1, 2026, sold under an automatic shelf registration statement via underwriters led by Barclays, BNP Paribas, BofA, Citi, J.P. Morgan and UBS. The Notes were issued October 5, 2026 under a base indenture with U.S. Bank Trust as trustee. This is an ordinary debt capital-markets takedown, not a special situation; no equity terms, premium, or deal mechanics apply. Watch for leverage and refinancing implications.
